topics.title: Living vs Nonliving
topics.description: Exploring what defines life and how nonliving things can still support living organisms.

topics.title: Properties of Life
topics.description: Identifying the key characteristics that separate living organisms from nonliving matter.

topics.title: Energy & Life
topics.description: Understanding the role of energy transfer in sustaining living systems.

classes_taught.raw_text: This course introduces students to foundational life science concepts. We begin by exploring the distinction between living and nonliving things, examining edge cases like the sun and stars that challenge simple classifications. Students will learn the properties of life including growth, reproduction, response to stimuli, and homeostasis.
